messages:
Samir Gupta: Quick sync: partners asked for a concrete handoff plan for H100/H200/B200 marketplace listing + joint announcement. We have mixed readiness across vendors. Propose phased playbook so we don't block GA.
Nora Li: Can you summarize vendor readiness? which parts are blocking?
Felix Ortega: Summary: NVIDIA H100 is green for NA/EU; H200 has a small firmware timing fix ETA 6/10 that affects 99th percentile latencies. B200 (partner B) reports a driver tweak for multi-tenant scheduling next week.
intel_bob: Intel (B200 partner) note: driver v4.1.7 addresses scheduler fairness; shipping to partners 2026-06-11, partner validation 3 days.
nvidia_anna: H200 microcode patch planned 2026-06-10, validation window ~1 week. We can provide embargoed perf numbers by 06-07.
Samir Gupta: Proposed playbook: 1) partner integrator preview (invite-only) 06-12-06-14, 2) marketplace "preview" listing (NA/EU) 06-20, 3) APAC listing after vendor validation windows close (aim early July), 4) joint press/GA when all regions validated.
Nora Li: Ops & Support asks: add UI state "Preview - limited throughput" + support runbook for fallback routing (default H200->H100->B200). Also need a banner for customers when fallback occurs.
Felix Ortega: I'll own perf mapping doc (H200->H100 delta table, B200 caveats). Will upload by 06-03.
intel_bob: We'll supply embargoed compatibility matrix and partner images by 06-08.
nvidia_anna: We'll send our microcode test logs by 06-05 and the embargoed numbers on 06-07.
Samir Gupta: SI dry-run dates: NA/EU 06-14, APAC 06-28. Can SI team run KV cache + multi-tenant perf checks?
Nora Li: Yes. We'll tag test images: `redwood/h100:preview-20260610`, `redwood/h200:preview-20260610`, `redwood/b200:preview-20260610`. Smoke test: `docker run --rm --gpus=all redwood/h200:preview-20260610 ./smoke.sh --concurrency 16 --p99`
legal-bot: Reminder: region availability changes require legal review before public listing. Attach approvals to the pipeline.
release-bot: Pipeline scheduled: `marketplace-preview` NA/EU 2026-06-20 17:00 UTC pending artifacts & signoffs.
Samir Gupta: Decisions: proceed with phased preview. Actions: Felix -> perf mapping, Nora -> support runbook + UI flag, Intel/NVIDIA -> embargoed matrices + images, Samir -> press cadence & calendar invites.
Felix Ortega: noted, will upload mapping 06-03 EOD.
Nora Li: I'll draft support Q&A and runbook by 06-05.
Samir Gupta: thanks everyone. tagging vendors: @intel_bob @nvidia_anna please confirm artifact delivery dates in-thread. :thumbsup:
